text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Nuclear Organisation AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × DEFENCE NUCLEAR ORGANISATION MOD Defence Nuclear Organisation AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK MOD Defence Nuclear Organisation — UK nuclear deterrent, AWE plc operations, submarine reactor programme, warhead maintenance, nuclear security, skills pipeline, environmental remediation, procurement oversight. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Deterrent UK Nuclear Deterrent — CASD, Trident D5, Dreadnought Programme Continuous At Sea Deterrent (CASD) — Vanguard-class submarine patrol cycle. Trident D5 missile system — Lockheed Martin, US/UK cooperation. Dreadnought-class replacement programme — 4 boats, BAE Systems Barrow-in-Furness. Warhead programme — AWE Aldermaston, Mk4A warhead, US/W76-1 common design. Penetration aid development. Fire control system — Mk7. Missile compartment — Common Missile Compartment shared with US Columbia-class. Programme cost — £31bn+ (2015 prices). Defence Nuclear Board oversight. AWE AWE plc Operations — Aldermaston, Burghfield, Production Atomic Weapons Establishment — UK's nuclear warhead design, manufacture, and maintenance facility. Aldermaston — warhead assembly, detonator production, high explosive manufacture, hydrodynamic testing. Burghfield — warhead refurbishment, final assembly, magazine storage. AWE plc — Lockheed Martin, Serco, Jacobs joint venture (until 2025). AWE Transition — MOD in-house management from 2025. Nuclear Weapons Council — US/UK warhead cooperation. Special Nuclear Material management. PFPE (Precision Firing and Fuzing Electronics). Submarine Submarine Reactor Programme — PWR3, Rolls-Royce, Derby Nuclear submarine reactor programme — Pressurised Water Reactor 3 (PWR3). Rolls-Royce submarine reactor facility — Raynesway, Derby. Reactor core manufacture — enriched uranium fuel. Steam raising equipment. Primary and secondary coolant circuits. Reactor protection system — safety-critical software. Refuelling complex — Devonport, HMNB Clyde. Reactor compartment manufacture — BAE Systems. Waste management — spent fuel rods, intermediate level waste. Reactor decommissioning — defuel and store. Waste Nuclear Waste Management — ILW, LLW, Decommissioning Nuclear waste management across defence nuclear estate. Intermediate Level Waste (ILW) — interim storage at AWE, Devonport, Rosyth, Sellafield transfer. Low Level Waste (LLW) — Drigg repository, Lillyhall. Very Low Level Waste (VLLW) — site clearance. Radioactive Waste Management Committee — MOD representative. Nuclear Decommissioning Authority — defence sector cooperation. Legacy waste — contaminated soils, redundant facilities. Active liquid waste treatment. Effluent monitoring. Environmental permits. ONR ONR Regulation — Nuclear Installations Inspectorate, Safety Cases Office for Nuclear Regulation — MOD nuclear sites licensing regime. Nuclear Installations Act 1965 — defence site exemptions (s.1(6) and s.2(6)). ONR MOD Inspectorate — dedicated defence nuclear inspectors. Safety case regime — pre-operational safety case, periodic safety review. Emergency Planning — ONR/DEFRA/SEPA joint assessment. Conventional nuclear safety — HSE regulations. Transport of radioactive materials — ONR Certificates of Approval. INES classification — incident reporting. Regulatory engagement strategy. Security Nuclear Security — AWE Police, Guard Force, Insider Threat Nuclear security across defence nuclear estate — AWE Constabulary, MOD Guard Force, Royal Marines nuclear security. Insider threat programme — personnel vetting (DV/SC), behaviour monitoring, access control.
